shortDescription: Manages configuration of an OSPF interface instanceon HUAWEI CloudEngine switches.

options.name: area
options.description: Ospf area associated with this ospf process. Valid values are a string, formatted as an IP address (i.e. "0.0.0.0") or as an integer between 1 and 4294967295.

options.name: auth_key_id
options.description: Authentication key id when C(auth_mode) is 'hmac-sha256', 'md5' or 'hmac-md5. Valid value is an integer is in the range from 1 to 255.

options.name: auth_text_md5
options.description: Specifies a password for MD5, HMAC-MD5, or HMAC-SHA256 authentication. The value is a string of 1 to 255 case-sensitive characters, spaces not supported.

options.name: auth_text_simple
options.description: Specifies a password for simple authentication. The value is a string of 1 to 8 characters.

options.name: cost
options.description: The cost associated with this interface. Valid values are an integer in the range from 1 to 65535.

options.name: dead_interval
options.description: Time interval an ospf neighbor waits for a hello packet before tearing down adjacencies. Valid values are an integer in the range from 1 to 235926000.

options.name: hello_interval
options.description: Time between sending successive hello packets. Valid values are an integer in the range from 1 to 65535.

options.name: process_id
options.description: Specifies a process ID. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 4294967295.

options.name: silent_interface
options.description: Setting to true will prevent this interface from receiving HELLO packets. Valid values are 'true' and 'false'.

options.name: state
options.description: Determines whether the config should be present or not on the device.
